what_i_found: Wind as a physical tool you carry: you catch a gust in your bell, hold it, and give it back to the world to turn a mill, ride an updraft, swing a bridge or calm a guardian, in a village built inside one great tree. Every puzzle and the boss fight are solved with the same few verbs of wind, never with a weapon.
